name: fieldcamp
description: Run your field service operation from the agent: today's schedule, who is free, booking jobs with priced line items, chasing unpaid invoices, client history and parts stock — backed by the FieldCamp MCP server.

FIELDCAMP_API_TOKEN.title: FieldCamp API token
FIELDCAMP_API_TOKEN.description: Create one in FieldCamp under Settings → API Keys. It starts with fc_live_. The token carries your own FieldCamp permissions, so the agent can only see and change what you already can.
